summary.text: 本 points to the root or base of a tree. It takes 木, “tree,” and adds a short horizontal mark near the bottom to highlight the roots. From this concrete meaning come the broader senses “origin,” “source,” and “basis.”

formation.text: A tree picture with a mark directing attention to its root.

components.text: 木 provides the tree whose lower part is being identified. It contributes the image and meaning, not the pronunciation.
The short horizontal stroke marks the root area. Its job here is to point to a place within the picture.

history.text: The mark works through position: placed at the bottom of 木, it singles out the base. The extension from a plant’s root to the foundation or source of other things follows that same image.
